model_annotation: The image displays two line plots comparing the training reward performance of two reinforcement learning methods—“Llama-On-Policy” and “Llama-LUFFY”—on “Easy” and “Hard” training sets. Both plots share the same axes: the x-axis is labeled “Steps,” ranging from 0 to 500 with tick marks at intervals of 100, and the y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards,” with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot. In the “Easy Training Set” plot, the teal “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” line and the red “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” line both rise rapidly from near 0.0 at step 0, reaching approximately 0.35 by step 500, with minor fluctuations and overlapping uncertainty bands. In the “Hard Training Set” plot, the red “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” line starts near 0.0, rises to about 0.1 by step 100, and gradually increases to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while the teal “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” line remains near 0.0 after an initial small rise, indicating little to no learning progress on the hard task.
